opening.argument: The offer presents a Litecoin cloud-mining service with visible plan choices, Litecoin-denominated prices, a 60-day runtime, and controls to place an order. It explains the proposed exchange: purchase a plan, begin mining, and receive daily returns, with mining said to start once payment is confirmed. Referral bonuses and a displayed payout table are further features of the presentation. Those are observable terms and interface elements of a commercial offer. The available evidence does not identify a mismatch between what is promised and what is delivered, nor does it establish an outcome. On this record, the presentation supports treating the video as an ordinary service promotion, without assuming that its advertised returns were either paid or withheld.
